If you mean **Richmond, Victoria (Melbourne)**, here are two good options:

- Cambridge Smart Locks – A specialist in smart lock sales and installation with a showroom on Bridge Road. They install a range of smart locks for homes and businesses and can help you choose a compatible model. [cambridgesmartlocks.com.au](https://cambridgesmartlocks.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Unlocked Locksmiths – A 24/7 emergency locksmith in Richmond that also installs electronic and smart locks, which is useful if you already have a lock ready to be fitted.

Typical installation pricing in Melbourne is often around **A$150–A$300** if you're supplying the lock, with higher costs if door modifications are needed or if the installer is supplying the hardware. [www.reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/AusRenovation/comments/1k6kchh?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you haven't bought a lock yet, I can also recommend the best options based on your needs, such as:
- Apple HomeKey (Apple users)
- Google Home / Alexa compatibility
- Keypad only
- Fingerprint access
- Rental or Airbnb use
- Budget under a specific amount (e.g. A$300).
